newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria First Inv Bank has 2.28 bln lev 96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria First Inv Bank has 2.28 bln lev 96 profit.

text.p: Bulgaria's private First Investment Bank (FIB) said it had posted 2.28 billion lev gross profit for 1996 which was fully set aside as provision against the bank's risk assets.
"The annual shareholders' meeting decided to set aside as provisions the total gross profit of 2.28 billion levs for last year," the bank said in a statement.
The shareholders also decided to raise capital to five billion levs from 2.2 billion levs in line with expected rise of Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) minimum capital requirements. @
The minimum capital required for a domestic banking operations now is set at 1.4 billion levs by the BNB while 2.2 billion levs are required for a full banking licence.
FIB was set up in 1993 as a fully private financial institution and was licensed for domestic and international banking operations.
The bank's capital to risk assets ratio was 15.16 percent at end-1996, the statement said. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
